description: Update the migration code generation to properly restore previous API rules during downgrade operations. Currently, when rolling back migrations that modify API rules, the system clears the rules instead of reverting them to their previous state, causing data loss. This feature should ensure that downgrade operations correctly preserve the original API rule configuration.
functional_requirements: Modify the migration template generation to include previous API rule values in the 'down' migration functions
Ensure the 'down' migration sets API rules to their exact previous state rather than clearing them
Maintain backward compatibility with existing migration patterns while fixing the rollback behavior
Update test cases to verify that downgrade operations correctly restore API rules to their original values
